review_type: independent readonly Spec review of narrow R04-to-R06 delta
spec_scope: Expose the same scenario allowed operations enforced by the existing policy gate to independent model questions, and retain self-contained validity context without duplicated candidate descriptions exceeding the unchanged input budget.
verified_by_static_inspection: jev_test_web.py:38 tells the operation question to choose effectful actions only from allowed_operations.
Shared state receives contract.policy(scenario)['allowed_operations'], which is the same scenario policy source used to initialize execution safety. It does not invent or broaden an allowlist.

Validity questions explicitly reference page.elements in shared state and carry their own sorted allowed_roles for click, check or fill. They no longer depend on another question's criteria or answer.
The shared public elements still contain sanitized names, states and nearby text. Removing the duplicated per-validity candidates map does not remove those observations.
Candidate presence remains insufficient and page text remains untrusted data in the validity instructions.
The 254-candidate limit, full serialized input budget check, confidence/validity/risk thresholds, origin restrictions, stale-state preflight and action authorization are unchanged.
The execution path still calls contract.action_denial before browser.preflight/browser.act; model instructions do not replace policy enforcement.

The revised request-state regression checks the actual scenario allowed operations and validity role group while retaining checkbox state/nearby-text assertions. The existing candidate-boundary test itself is unchanged.

preserved_regression_evidence_inspected.R05_observation: The existing candidate boundary test failed at the serialized input budget check; 22 tests ran with one error.
preserved_regression_evidence_inspected.R06_request_observation: PASS: jev web loop element context, fan-out questions, pass/risk/stall/premature-done, records

limitations: The task reports a prior live fill choice correctly blocked by unchanged policy. This review establishes that allowed operations are now visible to the model; it does not prove that all future model choices will comply.
The validity question remains independent through shared state plus its own role constraint. Model confidence and live reliability still require the separate comparison-r06 measurement.

The restored 254-candidate regression does not promise every possible 254-element payload fits the budget; longer sanitized labels or other context can still correctly fail closed at the unchanged limit.
Live comparison-r06 results were not reused as acceptance, and the correction is not asserted to be the sole root cause of prior uncertain or blocked outcomes.
conclusion: No missing, wrong or out-of-scope behavior found in the narrow R06 policy-context and bounded validity-context correction.
